I have been doing this 25 years, so I mostly follow what worked last year with small changes. I have 60 mu, which is a big piece of land for our village. My wife helps and I hire some people during wheat harvest and cotton picking. Two of my kids work in the city, so labor at home is limited.

For the wheat-maize rotation I will use 45 mu. That is my main income. Cotton I keep on 15 mu because prices jump around and picking takes too many workers, but the land near the road is sandy and cotton does better there than maize.

**Wheat (winter, 45 mu):** I will plant Jimai 22 again — it did well last year and the seed dealer still has it. I put about 50 jin of compound fertilizer (diammonium, 18-46-0 type) before ploughing, which gives roughly 9 kg N and 23 kg P per mu. Then at green-up in spring I topdress urea, about 20 jin per mu, that adds another 9 kg N. So total N around 18 kg/mu. Potassium I only add a little through compound fertilizer — our soil here has enough K, my father always said so and I see no problem. I irrigate before winter, then green-up, jointing, and grain-filling — 4 times. Spray pesticide maybe 2 times for aphids and powdery mildew. I use rotary tillage because plough is slow on 45 mu and the tractor rental is cheaper. I expect 500 kg/mu if weather is normal.

**Maize (summer, 45 mu after wheat):** Right after wheat I do no-till direct seeding with Zhengdan 958 — a hybrid, everyone uses it here. I apply 50 jin compound fertilizer (15-15-15) at sowing, about 7.5 kg each of N, P, K. Then at big trumpet stage I topdress 25 jin urea, another 11 kg N. So total N about 18-19 kg/mu. I irrigate twice if rain is poor — at sowing and around tasseling. One pesticide spray for corn borer, sometimes two if I see damage. Expected yield around 600 kg/mu.

**Cotton (spring, 15 mu):** I use improved seed from the county dealer, Bt cotton. Cotton eats more potassium, so I put 60 jin of 15-15-15 compound before planting and then 20 jin urea as topdressing at squaring. That gives me about 13 kg N, 9 kg P, 9 kg K. I irrigate 2 times from the well. Cotton needs many sprayings — aphids, spider mites, bollworm — I plan 4 applications but usually end up doing 5. Plough tillage for cotton because it needs deeper soil. Expect around 250 kg seed cotton per mu.

I would rather put a little extra fertilizer than lose yield. Fertilizer money I can recover if harvest is good; a bad harvest I cannot recover.
